title: Classify SDK transport-not-connected InvalidOperationException in daemon session recovery
outcome: A disconnected SDK session cannot remain established merely because its failure is surfaced as InvalidOperationException; unrelated request errors are not misclassified.
acceptance: First verify the documented disconnected-SDK path, then add decisive request and cancellation-forwarding regressions that distinguish completed/disconnected-session InvalidOperationException from unrelated InvalidOperationException. Observed connection loss invalidates only the matching connection, preserves typed uncertain outcome or caller cancellation, and allows later recovery without replay.
disposal_reason: Continue as independent P3 follow-up after completed shutdown fix w-4a910f482d1c. The review finding is non-blocking and its original review/parent evidence remains in the notes; no implementation has been attempted.
